code='''def transform(grid):
    # Restore the solid rectangular object and remove scattered background noise.
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 4]

        c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):

    return out
'''
